description: This file defines the Dimension class in the PhpSpreadsheet Helper namespace, providing methods and constants for handling cell dimension units, conversions between units, and internal calculations related to spreadsheet cell sizes.

classes.name: Dimension
classes.description: A helper class for managing and converting spreadsheet cell dimensions and units.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Dimension object by parsing a dimension string and converting it to internal units.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the dimension in pixels or cell units.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the dimension in points or pixels.

methods.name: toUnit
methods.description: Converts the stored dimension to a specified unit of measure.
